newsitem.title: CAMBODIA: Cambodian magnate opens bank in Battambang.
newsitem.headline: Cambodian magnate opens bank in Battambang.

text.p: Business magnate Kong Triv on Thursday opened a branch of his Pacific Commercial Bank in Battambang, becoming only the second commercial bank to operate in Cambodia's second largest city.
The new office is Pacific Commercial's ninth in Cambodia and is part of an aggressive effort to make gains in the fledgling Cambodian banking industry, according to Kong Triv, the bank's president.
"We will open an office in every province," he said. "Battambang is a big market. Goods from Thailand are traded through here, and the city is an agricultural centre."
Pacific Commercial plans to open seven more branches throughout Cambodia in the coming year, said Kong Triv.
Banking is one of Cambodia's least developed sectors, with few international players willing to enter an environment lacking strong laws or a complete commercial code.
But Kong Triv sees the nascent industry as a major growth opportunity and said he would target leading Cambodia business executives, who would be able to hold accounts in riel, baht or dollars.
Pacific Commercial is part of Kong Triv's KT Pacific Group Ltd.
